config.title: AMBA AXI4 — Write Burst, then Read with a Long Memory Latency
config.subtitle: 54 cycles · a 32-cycle read latency is folded away · INCR bursts, 4 beats, 32-bit data

foot.text: A transfer occurs on the rising edge of ACLK when VALID and READY are both asserted. Beats D0–D3 carry 0xA5A5_0000 + n.

//: c{n} means the brick c spans n steps, so 0{48} is 48 idle cycles.

signal.name: step
signal.desc: Step index — numbers jump across a fold

signal.name: ACLK
signal.desc: Global clock — all signals sampled on the rising edge

signal.name: ARESETn
signal.desc: Active-low global reset, de-asserted at cycle 1

signal.name: AWVALID
signal.desc: Master asserts: write address is valid

signal.name: AWREADY
signal.desc: Slave accepts the write address at cycle 3

signal.name: WVALID
signal.desc: Master drives write data for 5 cycles

signal.name: WREADY
signal.desc: Slave de-asserts at cycle 6 to back-pressure the burst

signal.name: WDATA
signal.desc: D2 is held across cycles 6–7 while WREADY is low

signal.name: WSTRB
signal.desc: Final beat is a partial write

signal.name: WLAST
signal.desc: Marks the final beat of the write burst

signal.name: RREADY
signal.desc: Master de-asserts at cycle 50 to throttle the slave
